scientific_integrity: Exact 1920-element finite Weyl-group computation with explicit integer-lattice proof and reproducible Python 3 certificate. Source results are attributed and independence is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Classifies the integral index of exceptional-curve Frobenius orbit-sum classes for smooth quartic del Pezzo surfaces; not the rational effective semigroup, Brauer group, or realizability of each type at each small field. Hidden older equivalent integral computations remain possible.
title: Integral Frobenius trace defects on quartic del Pezzo surfaces
